local_fragment_rule: Union same-user same-channel same-item same-airing positive overlap intervals; cap at airing duration; qualify when union/duration >=0.8. Require complete source views and complete airings before cutoff. Compare against single-view >=0.8 as a sensitivity check.
tie_rule: Descending qualifying-airing frequency, then ascending tv_show_id. Competition tie behavior unknown.
qualified_fusion: Same first fusion weights (popularity1, association0.25, repeat3), half-life14 repeat; association legacy population to isolate target correction. Qualified-airing counts replace 60-second session counts. No weight search.
selection_guard: Before diagnostic choose at most one corrected variant. Require improvement on both all-user and eligible-five MAP@5 in all three 84-day selection windows, with mean gain >=0.01 on eligible-five and no window loss worse than -0.005. This is reused diagnostic data, not independent confirmation. If none pass, retain first confirmed CSV.
uncertainties: Competition does not document fragment union, tie resolution, or exact ordered-MAP implementation. Local AP uses a set of five preferred IDs; report complete-five and all-user metrics.
